subject: Orion Systems — Joint Integration & Architecture Deep-Dive / Workshop kickoff
messages:
From: Anna Li <anna.li@orionsys.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: James Park <j.park@orionsys.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orion + Redwood — integration workshop request

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team found Redwood's routing and cache features compelling. Orion is moving towards a joint solution for our enterprise customers (we're targeting a pilot with Bison Health in Q4) and we'd like to set up a focused architecture deep-dive / integration workshop with your SREs and solutions engineers.

High-level goals:
- Validate network and data flow for private deployment (VPC peering, egress policies)
- Confirm acceptable latency profiles with 5k RPS patterns and batching
- Discuss marketplace packaging and telemetry requirements for publishing to CloudMarketplace

We can commit to a 2.5 hour working session with engineers + an additional 30-minute executive sync if needed. Proposed week: Aug 9–13 (US time).

Two immediate asks: can you share a simple agenda and your available slots? Also, any prep docs we should review (network diagrams, required IAM roles)? I've attached a first-pass agenda and our sample network topology.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Li
Director, Strategic Integrations
Orion Systems
Attachment: orion-workshop-proposed-agenda-v1.pdf, orion-sample-network-topology.png

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@orionsys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orion + Redwood — integration workshop request

Anna — thanks for the clear goals and the attachments, very helpful.

We'd be happy to run the deep-dive. Quick notes and suggestions:
- Format: 2.5 hour hands-on engineering session (network & infra) + 30 min exec alignment (product + partnerships).
- Prep: please share any existing SAML/KMS choices on your side; we'll prepare a Redwood Private checklist and a short runbook for peering & egress.
- Slots: Aug 10 (Tue) 13:00–15:30 PT, Aug 11 (Wed) 10:00–12:30 PT, Aug 12 (Thu) 15:00–17:30 PT — pick one and we’ll work to lock it.

Marissa and Karthik are copied for logistics and technical scope. Marissa: can you own the calendar invite and Zoom? Karthik: please review the attached agenda and flag any infra agenda items to add.

I also pulled our marketplace contact — Elaine Zhou — in case we need to cover packaging and catalog artifacts during the exec sync. Elaine, are you available to join the last 30 mins on any of the slots above?

Best,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-private-checklist.md (stub)

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@orionsys.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Elaine Zhou <elaine.zhou@cloudmarketplace.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orion + Redwood — integration workshop request

Thanks Vivek — locking down logistics.

Hi Anna / James — I can send a calendar invite for Aug 11, Wed 10:00–12:30 PT (we'll do 10:00–12:30 PT engineering session + 12:30–13:00 PT exec sync). Proposed Zoom link is here: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=workshop.

Quick attendees we plan to include from Redwood:
- Vivek Kulkarni (Partnerships)
- Marissa Cole (Partner Ops) — logistics/AM
- Karthik Iyer (Solutions Engineer) — infra deep-dive
- Lina Hsu (SRE) — runtime/latency tuning (TBD — will confirm)

Tell me if you need any additional roles from our side (security/compliance reviewer). I will attach the final agenda and a link to the prep drive.

Attachment: redwood-final-agenda-v1.pdf (to follow)

Cheers,
Marissa

From: Anna Li <anna.li@orionsys.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: James Park <j.park@orionsys.com>, Elaine Zhou <elaine.zhou@cloudmarketplace.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 07:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orion + Redwood — integration workshop request

Marissa — Aug 11 works for us. Thanks for including Lina — having an SRE is important. A couple of clarifying items before we finalize:

1) Network prep: James will provide our ASN/VPC CIDR and the expected egress endpoints by tomorrow. Please confirm if you need an IP allowlist for any outbound monitoring endpoints.

2) Test data: Orion can provide a sanitized sample dataset for a dry-run. Is there a preferred format (JSONL, parquet)?

3) Marketplace artifacts: Elaine — if you join the exec sync, we want to confirm the required manifest fields and a rough timeline for listing.

We'll look out for your calendar invite and final agenda.

Best,
Anna

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@orionsys.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Elaine Zhou <elaine.zhou@cloudmarketplace.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orion + Redwood — integration workshop request

Great — calendar invite sent. Final logistics and quick asks in the event notes:

- Calendar: Aug 11, 10:00–13:00 PT (engineering 10:00–12:30, exec sync 12:30–13:00). Zoom + dial-in in the invite.
- Prep drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1OrionWorkshopPrep (agenda, network diagram, sample payload schema)
- Network: James, please post the ASN/CIDR and egress endpoints in this thread or to the drive by EOD tomorrow so Karthik/Lina can pre-author rules.
- Test data: JSONL preferred (one JSON per line, obfuscated PII).
- Marketplace: Elaine — please flag any template docs we should pre-fill (we can have a draft by Aug 9).
- Attachments: I attached the final agenda to the invite (redwood-final-agenda-v1.pdf).

Looking forward to the session. If anything changes I'll update the invite (ping me directly).

Thanks,
Marissa
Partner Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
